name: produce output with zero external library dependencies
definition: compile with only standard system libraries, referencing no project-local modules or headers and no reads of the reference image file.
failure_mode: a reference to a local include, runtime file, or non-libc dependency because binary would fail the isolation run or the header check

name: read a chess position from an image
definition: Interpret a chess-board photograph/PNG into a structured legal position (piece placement, side to move).

name: read a legacy raw disk image at its partition offset
definition: Determine the partition offset of a disk and extract individual files from it with filesystem tools to prove the installation is present.
failure_mode: a wrong offset or missing files fail file verification

name: record the interpreter path used for successful rendering in a pointer file
definition: Write the absolute path of the working python interpreter to the expected location accessible by the unprivileged user.
failure_mode: Empty, missing, or non-executable interpreter path fails the checks
